name: Discovery Curiosity Engine
description: Configuration for deciding what Discovery should explore next.

decisionFactors.guidance: Prioritize areas where the participant shows energy, care, hesitation, pride, frustration, or curiosity.
Explore areas where an observation exists but evidence is thin or mostly inferred.
Stay curious when confidence does not match the importance of the emerging insight.
Return to repeated themes when they appear across different stories or domains.
Explore both sides of tension without forcing resolution.
Seek validation when the next move touches identity, meaning, values, motivations, self-description, or personal narrative.

selectionGuidance: Choose exploration when meaning is emerging.
Choose evidence questions when support is thin.
Choose reflection when a tentative pattern may help the participant refine understanding.
Choose validation when identity-adjacent understanding is being formed.
Choose pause or summary when participant comfort or readiness suggests slowing down.
